caption:
A coupon changes the total, but that is not always a change to the product-page price.

When writing an offer, say which amount you mean. Keep product-price history separate from a customer’s final total after codes or automatic discounts.

India Prior Price records product price changes. It does not provide a complete history of every customer’s final checkout discount.

That limit matters when you explain a sale. Coming soon. Follow for launch.
